what was the master project about.answer: It forecast a model's final validation loss from only the first fraction of its training curve, so weak runs could be stopped early [1]. It compared two foundation-model families, ifBO/FT-PFN and TabPFN-style predictors, across 14 strategies for choosing which completed runs to condition on, over four model scales [1][2]. The two families turned out to differ sharply in how stable their uncertainty was — visible only when judging by interval scores and coverage rather than point accuracy [1].

which retrievers does this bot use.answer: BM25 and a reduced TF-IDF (LSA) retriever, plus a hybrid that fuses the two [1]. All three run entirely in the browser over an index built from the public documents; only the final answer is generated by a model, behind a rate-limited proxy holding the API key [1].
